## kb chunking get

Get how a space is cut into sections

For someone who reads the space: the application’s default chunking, the space’s own override and the one in effect, and whether its documents are being cut again.

```bash
nb-studio kb chunking get --scope <string>
```

| Flag      | Type   | Description                                                                                                         |
| --------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--scope` | string | (required)                                                                                                          |
| `--owner` | string | What the space belongs to within `--scope`, such as the project’s id; none for a scope with one space. (default "") |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/knowledge/chunking` (`knowledgeGetChunking`)

## kb chunking set

Set how a space is cut into sections

Requires `manage` on the space. `override` replaces the application’s default for this space, or null follows it again. When the chunking in effect changes, every document of the space is cut again in the background, and re-indexed when semantic search is on.

```bash
nb-studio kb chunking set
```

| Flag         | Type   | Description                                                                                                         |
| ------------ | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--scope`    | string |                                                                                                                     |
| `--owner`    | string | What the space belongs to within `--scope`, such as the project’s id; none for a scope with one space. (default "") |
| `--override` | json   | The space’s own chunking; null follows the application’s default.                                                   |
| `--file`     | path   | The request body as a JSON object; the flags override its fields.                                                   |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `PUT /api/knowledge/chunking` (`knowledgeUpdateChunking`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio kb chunking set --file ./chunking.json
```

## kb doc create

Create an article or a folder

Requires `edit` on the parent, or on the space at the top. The slug is derived from the title unless given. Files are uploaded with `knowledgeUploadDoc`.

```bash
nb-studio kb doc create --scope <string> --title <string>
```

| Flag        | Type       | Description                                                                                                         |
| ----------- | ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--scope`   | string     | (required)                                                                                                          |
| `--owner`   | string     | What the space belongs to within `--scope`, such as the project’s id; none for a scope with one space. (default "") |
| `--kind`    | article \\ | folder                                                                                                              |     |
| `--parent`  | string     |                                                                                                                     |
| `--title`   | string     | (required)                                                                                                          |
| `--slug`    | string     |                                                                                                                     |
| `--summary` | string     |                                                                                                                     |
| `--content` | string     | (or --content-file <path>)                                                                                          |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/knowledge/docs` (`knowledgeCreateDoc`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio kb doc create --scope system --title "Conventions" --content-file ./conventions.md
```

| `--slug`    | string |                                                                                                                     |

## kb download

Download a knowledge file

A file's original bytes by slug or id, as an attachment; `kb read` gives its extracted text.

```bash
nb-studio kb download <doc>
```

| Argument | Description                   |
| -------- | ----------------------------- |
| `doc`    | The document: its slug or id. |

| Flag        | Type    | Description                                                                                                                            |
| ----------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--version` | integer | An older version instead of the current one.                                                                                           |
| `--project` | string  | A project's id: read its knowledge too. A run on an issue reads its project's without it, and a conversation the projects it is about. |
| `--out`     | path    | Where to save the file, or a directory to save it in.                                                                                  |

**Output:** A file, saved in the current directory under its own name or where `--out` says; with `--json`, `result.data` says where it went.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `kb.knowledge/read`.

**Request:** `GET /api/kb/docs/{doc}/file` (`kbDownloadDoc`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio kb download budget-xlsx --out ./budget.xlsx
```

## kb list

List the knowledge documents

The documents the caller reads in the spaces read (with the system's), each with the page that shows it. `q` keeps those matching the words, best first; `parent` one document's children. A bounded list, not paged.

```bash
nb-studio kb list
```

| Flag        | Type   | Description                                                                                                                            |
| ----------- | ------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--q`       | string | Only documents matching these words (title, summary or text).                                                                          |
| `--parent`  | string | Only this document's children (slug or id).                                                                                            |
| `--project` | string | A project's id: read its knowledge too. A run on an issue reads its project's without it, and a conversation the projects it is about. |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `slug`, `title`, `kind`, `space`, `version`, `summary`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `kb.knowledge/read`.

**Request:** `GET /api/kb/docs` (`kbListDocs`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio kb list
nb-studio kb list --parent known-pitfalls
```

## kb proposal accept

Accept a proposal

Requires `edit` where the proposal applies. Applies it as the document's next version (or a new document), authored by its proposer. A stale `update` is refused unless `confirmStale` is true, which makes its content the next version whole.

```bash
nb-studio kb proposal accept <proposal>
```

| Argument   | Description |
| ---------- | ----------- |
| `proposal` |             |

| Flag              | Type    | Description |
| ----------------- | ------- | ----------- |
| `--comment`       | string  |             |
| `--confirm-stale` | boolean |             |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/knowledge/proposals/{proposalId}/accept` (`knowledgeAcceptProposal`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio kb proposal accept <proposal> --comment "Thanks"
```

## kb propose

Propose a knowledge change

For someone who may edit to decide: an update (`doc` with `content`), a verification (`doc` with `verify`), a new document (`title` with `content`), or, as `multipart/form-data`, one proposal per changed file of the run's mounted knowledge (`files`, each named by its path in `.nocobase-runner/knowledge`). A run proposes at most 3 times, and one waits per document at a time. Answers the proposal (201), or each file's outcome.

```bash
nb-studio kb propose --reason <string>
```

| Flag        | Type       | Description                                                                                                                                                       |
| ----------- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--doc`     | string     | The document to update or verify (slug or id).                                                                                                                    |
| `--title`   | string     | A new document’s title.                                                                                                                                           |
| `--slug`    | string     | A new document’s slug.                                                                                                                                            |
| `--parent`  | string     | A new document’s parent (slug or id).                                                                                                                             |
| `--space`   | project \\ | system                                                                                                                                                            | Where a new document goes without a parent: the project read (default) or the system. |
| `--content` | string     | The whole new Markdown content. (or --content-file <path>)                                                                                                        |
| `--summary` | string     | A one-line summary.                                                                                                                                               |
| `--reason`  | string     | Why it should change, for the person deciding (at most 500 characters). (required)                                                                                |
| `--project` | string     | A project's id: read its knowledge too. A run on an issue reads its project's without it, and a conversation the projects it is about.                            |
| `--verify`  | boolean    | With `doc`: the document still holds; nothing in it changes.                                                                                                      |
| `--changed` | boolean    | Propose every file you changed or added in .nocobase-runner/knowledge (compared with its .manifest.json). (sends the files changed in .nocobase-runner/knowledge) |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `kb.knowledge/propose`.

**Request:** `POST /api/kb/proposals` (`kbPropose`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio kb propose --changed --reason "Learned while fixing the lists"
nb-studio kb propose --doc conventions --content-file ./kb.md --reason "..."
nb-studio kb propose --doc conventions --verify --reason "Still true"
```

A document by slug or id, at its current version or `version`. `meta.message` is its Markdown, with a note when the run's mounted copy is older.

```

| `doc`    | The document: its slug or id. |

| `--version` | integer | An older version instead of the current one.                                                                                           |
| `--project` | string  | A project's id: read its knowledge too. A run on an issue reads its project's without it, and a conversation the projects it is about. |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `kb.knowledge/read`.

**Request:** `GET /api/kb/docs/{doc}` (`kbReadDoc`)

```

## kb search

Search the knowledge

Hits in articles and files' text the caller reads, over the spaces read, each section once at its best score: its document, section, lines and the page at that heading. A ranking has no next page.

```bash
nb-studio kb search <query>
```

| Argument | Description                               |
| -------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `query`  | The words, quoted when there are several. |

| Flag        | Type    | Description                                                                                                                            |
| ----------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--limit`   | integer | At most this many hits. (default 20)                                                                                                   |
| `--project` | string  | A project's id: read its knowledge too. A run on an issue reads its project's without it, and a conversation the projects it is about. |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `slug`, `title`, `section`, `lines`, `excerpt`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `kb.knowledge/read`.

**Request:** `GET /api/kb/search` (`kbSearch`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio kb search "release checklist"
```

| `--type`  | string  |                                                                                                                     |
| `--limit` | integer | (default 20)                                                                                                        |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `type`, `id`, `label`, `hint`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/knowledge/subjects` (`knowledgeListSubjects`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio kb subject list --scope system --q alice
```

## kb tree

Get the knowledge documents as a tree

Each space read with its documents, the system’s last. `meta.message` draws the tree with each slug and summary.

```bash
nb-studio kb tree
```

| Flag        | Type   | Description                                                                                                                            |
| ----------- | ------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--project` | string | A project's id: read its knowledge too. A run on an issue reads its project's without it, and a conversation the projects it is about. |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `kb.knowledge/read`.

**Request:** `GET /api/kb/tree` (`kbGetTree`)

## kb upload

Propose a knowledge file

A new file, or with `doc` a new version of a file, for someone who may edit to decide. Answers a one-time ticket: the file goes as the body of a `POST` to its `url` with its `headers` (`knowledgeRedeemTicket`), which answers the proposal; its text is extracted once accepted. A run proposes at most 3 times.

```bash
nb-studio kb upload --reason <string> --file <path>
```

| Flag        | Type       | Description                                                                                                                            |
| ----------- | ---------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--doc`     | string     | The file to replace (slug or id).                                                                                                      |
| `--title`   | string     | A new file's title; its name when absent.                                                                                              |
| `--parent`  | string     | A new file's folder or document (slug or id).                                                                                          |
| `--space`   | project \\ | system                                                                                                                                 | Where a new document goes without a parent: the project read (default) or the system. |
| `--summary` | string     | A one-line summary.                                                                                                                    |
| `--reason`  | string     | Why it belongs in the knowledge base, for the person deciding (at most 500 characters). (required)                                     |
| `--project` | string     | A project's id: read its knowledge too. A run on an issue reads its project's without it, and a conversation the projects it is about. |
| `--file`    | path       | The file to propose. (required; streamed to an upload ticket, at most 104857600 bytes)                                                 |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `kb.knowledge/propose`.

**Request:** `POST /api/kb/uploadTickets` (`kbCreateUploadTicket`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio kb upload --file ./runbook.pdf --parent runbooks --reason "The on-call runbook"
nb-studio kb upload --doc queue-md --file ./queue.md --reason "The runbook changed"
```
